paper.title_en: Minimal input dimension for superactivation of one-shot zero-error quantum capacity
paper.abstract_en: The one-shot zero-error quantum capacity $\overline{Q}_0$ is studied within the framework of noncommutative graphs of quantum channels. The additivity of $\overline{Q}_0$ is proved for an arbitrary finite collection of channels with two-dimensional input spaces. An explicit pair of noncommutative graphs $S,T\subset M_3$ exhibiting superactivation of the one-shot zero-error quantum capacity is also constructed. Together, these results establish that the minimum input dimension for such superactivation is $3$.
